name: BarkBoard abnormal reboot detected
message: A BarkBoard device just reported an abnormal reboot (panic, watchdog timeout, or brownout). reportBootEvent() now fires a Datadog Event on every boot, tagged alert_type:info for a routine reset/power-cycle and alert_type:error only for these — status:error in the query scopes this monitor to real crashes only. Check {{event.text}} and the device's barkboard.task.stack_free / barkboard.heap.* around this time.
